input.quote: (c) The relationship of the Parties is that of independent contractors, and nothing herein is intended, nor should be construed, to create a partnership, agency, joint venture or employment relationship. No act or statement of either Party will operate to bind the other and neither Party will hold itself out or have any authority as an agent of the other for any purposes whatsoever.
input.rationale: Exhaustive review: we read all 75 paragraphs of the Agreement in full (not keyword search alone) and confirm there is no non-solicitation, no-hire, anti-poaching or inducement covenant anywhere. The General Provisions block (p0063-p0073) and the Confidentiality section (p0056-p0061) - the two places such a covenant customarily sits - contain none; the survival list at p0070 likewise identifies no restrictive covenant. Literal searches for "solicit", "employ", "hire", "induce", "recruit", "engage", "personnel" and "non-compete", plus a regex for "(shall|will) not (solicit|hire|employ|engage|induce)", return nothing responsive. The only employment-related provisions are the independent-contractor/no-agency clause quoted above (p0066), the mutual indemnities covering third parties "hired by, employed, retained or under" a party's control (p0051-p0052), and the need-to-know disclosure limit at p0061; none restricts The Associated Press from soliciting or hiring Kubient personnel. Our preferred position - no non-solicit binding the Customer - is therefore already met, so no redline is proposed and the rendered text is identical to the original. The deterministic sub-checks for a general-solicitation carve-out and a duration of 12 months or less cannot pass and are non-probative: both presuppose an existing covenant, and satisfying them would require inserting a non-solicit that does not exist, which would create a new restriction against our own client. We will not add one. If Kubient later proposes a non-solicit, our fallback is a mutual clause limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, 12 months from the end of that involvement, with carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches, and no no-hire.
